unsupported_claims: The paper describes its training as asynchronous SGD in the Hogwild style (the evidence mentions ASGD in the multi-worker case but not Hogwild)
The speedup scales nearly linearly with the number of workers (the evidence does not report a speedup figure or scaling behavior)
The experiments used on the order of 20 workers (the evidence does not state the number of workers used)
rationale: The answer correctly declines to give an exact worker count, but it then asserts a speedup scaling of nearly linear and a roughly 20-worker figure that the evidence does not contain. The evidence only supports that asynchronous SGD is used in the multi-worker case and that the approach is parallelizable, so the specific speedup and Hogwild attribution are unsupported.
